units.evidence: versionUtils.ts:36-51 (validateReleaseDecision), :93-110 (resolveVersionFiles: 'Expected a release definition file to only reference existing workspaces'), :217-229 (getWorkspaceByIdent); scripts/release/01-release-tags.sh:33 (yarn version apply --all at release); integration-workflow.yml:128
units.alint: yaml_path_matches $.releases.* - yarnpkg-berry-version-file-strategies-valid; cross_file superset (versioned workspace names vs a line regex over version-file keys and list items) - yarnpkg-berry-version-file-idents-exist
units.reason: It is enforced in two places: the PR check for that PR's file, and `version apply --all` over every file at release. Mapping keys are read with a line regex because JSONPath cannot select keys. Yarn always writes this layout (stringifySyml).
units.fire_verified: n/a (family other). Fired anyway: strategy 'patchy' gave 1 finding and '4.10.0-rc.1' gave 0. An unknown declined ident gave 1, an unknown release key gave 1, and an unversioned @yarnpkg/docusaurus release gave 1. The clone gives 0.

changes.why: The ident-existence half reads YAML mapping keys with a line regex over the text, because JSONPath cannot select keys. Stage A's own 'unusual' note names this as the same gap that made units 02 and 19 C, so treat it consistently. The regex also does not express the check faithfully (R4). Yarn parses version files with js-yaml (parseSyml -> parseViaJsYaml), so flow style is valid. In scratch, `releases: {"@yarnpkg/nope": patch}` and `declined: ["@yarnpkg/nope"]` gave 0 findings, though yarn rejects both (getWorkspaceByIdent at PR time; resolveVersionFiles at release for releases). The rule also over-flags: `declined: - "@yarnpkg/docusaurus"` gave 1 finding, but yarn's openVersionFile only requires that a declined ident exists, not that it is versioned. The strategies half (yaml_path_matches) is A-quality, apart from a leading-zero prerelease edge case (see config_issues).

units.summary: The website's configuration schemas (static/configuration/manifest.json, yarnrc.json) are valid draft 2019-09 JSON Schemas.
units.evidence: packages/docusaurus/tests/schema.test.ts:1-23 (ajv meta-validation, runs in yarn test:unit at integration-workflow.yml:300)
units.alint: missing: a meta-schema mode for json_schema_passes that validates a document as a JSON Schema of its declared draft using bundled metaschemas
units.reason: R7: a data-file assertion. json_schema_passes needs the 2019-09 meta-schema and its vocabulary files inside the repository. Probed in scratch: a $ref to the draft URI fails offline with 'Retrieving external resources is not supported', and the repository has no unzipped meta-schema.

changes.why: Stage A's probe was wrong. json_schema_passes resolves the bundled draft 2019-09 meta-schema offline when the shim schema declares it as both `$schema` and `$ref`: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema","$ref":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema"}. I tested this on the clone, with the shim outside the root and `allow_out_of_root: true`. Both manifest.json and yarnrc.json pass. Mutations fire: type=42 gave 1, required as a string gave 1, minLength -1 gave 1. The error Stage A saw appears only when the shim has no `$schema` (default-draft registry) or uses the `#`-suffixed URI. No new adapter is needed. What makes it awkward is that the repo has no shim file, so the config needs an out-of-root shim plus allow_out_of_root, or an inline-schema or meta-schema preset. That is tuning, so C.

Bundles were probed (oss-baseline, node, monorepo, monorepo/yarn-workspace, hygiene/lockfiles, tooling/editorconfig, toolchain-pins, ci/github-actions) and deliberately not extended, since the repo enforces none of their findings. They reported 56 gha-pin-actions-to-sha, 30 gha-workflow-contents-read, 10 monorepo-packages-have-readme, 9 yarn-workspace-member-has-readme, 2 monorepo-packages-have-package-json (packages/berry-cli, packages/esbuild-plugin-pnp), and 1 each of oss-security-policy-non-empty, oss-no-trailing-whitespace, oss-dependency-update-tool and node-engine-or-nvmrc.
absent_categories: locale: no locale or translation files and no i18n tooling (the locale family is empty for this repo)
hooks: no husky, lefthook, pre-commit, lint-staged or committed git hooks (e2e-husky-workflow tests husky support and is not a repo hook)
other CI systems: no GitLab CI, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins or Buildkite (GitHub Actions plus a Netlify deploy preview only)
task runners: no Makefile, justfile or Taskfile
toolchain pin files: no .nvmrc, .node-version, .tool-versions or Volta; the toolchain-pins bundle is silent. Node policy lives in engines.node, yarn.config.cjs and CI matrices
dependency-policy tools: no syncpack, manypkg or sherif config (yarn constraints plays that role); no renovate or dependabot
catalogs: .yarnrc.yml has a single catalog entry (typescript) with no catalog-use gate; catalog use is only incidental to the one-range constraint
license headers / SPDX in sources: none (licence is the per-manifest field set by constraints)
import layering / module boundaries: none beyond eslint no-restricted-imports (D)
file-graph: no cycle, orphan or layering gate; 1 registry-to-members edge (README e2e list <-> .github/workflows/e2e-*.yml, edge source a content regex)
unusual: The repository dogfoods its own policy engine. yarn.config.cjs is run by the yarn under test, executed from sources through scripts/run-yarn.js (yarnPath). Its nine constraint calls give ten units.

Deferred versioning. .yarn/versions/<hash>.yml records per-PR release and decline decisions, `yarn version check` diffs against the merge-base, and `yarn version apply --all` consumes every file at release. This yields a static, alint-checkable integrity unit and two change-set and join units (B).
Doc drift. contributing.mdx:89-97 says constraints live in constraints.pro and mentions `inline_compile`, but constraints.pro is now a deprecation stub pointing to yarn.config.cjs.

packages/berry-cli (bin/berry.js only, a release copy for Yarn 1 `policies set-version`) and packages/esbuild-plugin-pnp (README only) have no package.json. They are not workspaces, and monorepo@v1 flags them.

stage_b_summary:
I reviewed Stage A's yarnpkg/berry record at f359f65c1f8bb2efb051b3e55edcdc3cb461d159 and it holds up well overall. Most of its claims reproduce, and I found one missed unit, three reclassifications, one removal, and one alint bug.

**Missed unit (1, A):**
- **What it is.** MountFS.ts:17 says "Those values must be synced with .../esm-loader/fspatch.ts", and fspatch.ts:57 says the same back. Two values must agree:
  - MOUNT_MASK must equal ZIP_MASK.
  - MountFS's default magicByte 0x2a must equal ZIP_MAGIC's high byte.
- **Why it counts.** It is a load-bearing comment under R5, like sortMap (unit 21), and Stage A's search missed it.
- **Verified.** Two cross_file equals rules pass on the clone and each fires once on a broken scratch copy.

**Reclassifications:**
- **Unit 18, A to C.** It reads YAML keys with a line regex, the same JSONPath key gap Stage A used to make 02 and 19 C.
  - It misses flow-style version files, which yarn accepts: 0 findings for an unknown ident.
  - It wrongly flags an unversioned workspace in `declined:`.
- **Unit 23, B-adapter to C.** Stage A said alint cannot meta-validate offline; that is wrong.
  - json_schema_passes validates both docs schemas against the bundled draft 2019-09 meta-schema on the clone, given a shim schema that sets `$schema` and `$ref` to the 2019-09 URI. It fires on invalid schemas.
  - The only awkward part is the shim: the repo has none, so it must live outside the root with allow_out_of_root.
- **Unit 09, family toolchain-pin to other (moderate confidence).** Three ES-target sites agreeing with each other is not a Node or package-manager pin.

**Removal:**
- **Unit 43 (CODEOWNERS, D).** Enforcement cannot be verified from the clone. It only matters if branch protection requires code-owner review.

**Config and alint findings:**
- **alint bug.** `git_tracked_only: true` does not catch force-added gitignored files under the default respect_gitignore. The documentation's own target/ example gives 0 findings. Unit 26 stays C, but fixing this bug would make it expressible without listing directories.
- **Strategies regex too loose.** It accepts `4.10.0-01`, which node-semver rejects.
- **Unit 19's rule is narrower than the convention.** It checks releases, but the guide says "modify".
- **Hand lists in 02, 19 and 26 go stale silently.** A new workspace, plugin or directory is simply not covered.
- **Unit 11's rule does not cover `env.node-version: '18.x'`.** Nothing states that value is the minimum, so this is a note, not a defect.

**Confirmed:**
- validate-config reports 24 rules and check passes on the clone with 0 findings.
- I reproduced every dep-version and toolchain-pin A fire test (units 03, 04, 08, 09, 11), with negative controls.
- The other spot checks (02, 12, 13, 15) and Stage A's claims also held:
  - the editorconfig count of 94;
  - git_no_denied_paths matching across '/' (14 hits);
  - unit 01 holding statically on the clone;
  - unit 17 passing a static check of all 8 version files;
  - the locale family being empty;
  - no hooks, task runners, other CI systems or pin files.
- No other dep-version or toolchain-pin unit was missed. Nothing ties the remaining Node sites to engines.node: packageManager, the CI env values, Netlify's NODE_VERSION, and the prepare action's 25.6 default.

cross_file equals, normalize: lower. Source: 'magicByte\s*=\s*0x([0-9a-fA-F]{2}),' over MountFS.ts, which holds the default 0x2a.
